enchantments.tooltip: Deathblock: The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.
Frozen Depths Lore +9: Passive: Your Negative, Poison and Cold spells gain a +9% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Frozen Depths +63: Passive: +63 Equipment bonus to Negative, Cold and Poison Spell Power.

Crushing Wave Guard: This item stores the unstoppable force of the ocean's fury deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this power occasionally comes to the surface, crushing enemies beneath a torrent of frigid water.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
